_comment: The bootstrap payload: every file an operator puts on the USB stick for a bare unit,
staged flat beside bootstrap.ps1, which finds them via $PSScriptRoot. One list, read
by prov.bootstrap_payload to stage it and to snapshot it on the relay as
bootstrap-payload/<hash>/. Each path is repo-relative and resolves from the repo,
else from the machine-wide asset cache, exactly as a provider asset does.
vm/build-autounattend-iso.ps1 stages the same files for the dev VM, plus its VM-only
extras; a test keeps the two lists from drifting.
